column.text:
The Exchange Column

Bitcoin is in a risk-off regime, and the tape is telling you to respect it. The most important signal is the combination of extreme long skew, persistent ETF outflows, and a Fear & Greed reading of 11, deep in Extreme Fear. BTC's 1-day RSI sits at 23.27, which is oversold, but oversold alone is not a reason to buy. Flows confirm the pressure. Tuesday's BTC ETF figure of −$30.4M is partial, with issuers still reporting, but the 7-day net is −$1087.8M. ETH posted +$1.3M on Tuesday, also partial, against a 7-day net of −$406.0M. SOL was flat on Tuesday at $0.0M, with a 7-day net of −$20.4M. Capital is leaving the wrapper, not coming back in. The desk read points to a downside correction toward $62,500 before any stabilization. The main risk is a cascade of long liquidations if price breaks immediate support. Hyperliquid books show heavy net shorts on BTC and ETH, so momentum favors sellers. Longs need a real mechanism: deeply negative funding, a capitulation reading, a demand catalyst, or a failed breakdown. A dip by itself will not do it. Dollar liquidity is flat, so there is no macro tailwind to lean on. Trade the structure. Until price proves otherwise, sellers own the tape, and the next decisive move is more likely lower.
